### REQ-002: Message and MessageQueue (thread-safe)

- **Status:** DONE
- **Added:** 2026-04-07
- **Completed:** 2026-04-07
- **Verified by:** idf.py build clean compile 2026-04-07
- **Depends on:** REQ-001
- **Description:**

Port the `Message` and `MessageQueue` classes from the legacy codebase (`include/message.h`, `src/message.cpp`) into the ESP-IDF project. The legacy `MessageQueue` uses `std::queue<Message>` which is not thread-safe. Since ESP-IDF runs multiple FreeRTOS tasks, the queue must be protected.

#### Message class

Port as-is. Carries a `message_t` enum (room_get, room_set, room_actual, room_output, device_get, device_set), an MQTT topic string, and a JSON payload string. Uses ArduinoJson for `GetJsonDoc()`.

#### MessageQueue class

Same interface as legacy (`PushMessage`, `ReadMessage`, `PopMessage`, `GetSize`) but with a mutex protecting the internal `std::queue`. The MQTT callback (running in the MQTT task context) pushes messages, while the control task pops them — these run in different FreeRTOS tasks.

#### Location

`espidf/main/core/message.h` and `espidf/main/core/message.cpp` (new `core/` subdirectory for framework-agnostic application logic).

- **Acceptance criteria:**
  - [x] `message_t` enum ported with all six message types
  - [x] `Message` class compiles and works with ArduinoJson under ESP-IDF
  - [x] `MessageQueue` is protected by a FreeRTOS mutex (`SemaphoreHandle_t` or `std::mutex`)
  - [x] Push from one task and pop from another works without corruption (verified by test or code review)
  - [x] Project builds cleanly with `idf.py build`
- **Notes:**
  `std::mutex` is available in ESP-IDF (it wraps FreeRTOS mutexes). Either `std::mutex` or a raw `SemaphoreHandle_t` is acceptable.
